title: Procyanidin alleviates ferroptosis and inflammation of LPS-induced RAW264.7 cell via the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway.
authors: Zeng, Jiayan; Weng, Yanmin; Lai, Tianli; Chen, Lan; Li, Ying; Huang, Qiqi; Zhong, Saiyi; Wan, Shibiao; Luo, Lianxiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究原花青素通过Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解LPS诱导的巨噬细胞铁死亡和炎症，虽含分子对接与MD，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is a common occurrence in many medical conditions and is a natural defense mechanism of the human body. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of cell death related to lipid peroxide build-up, has been found to be involved in inflammation. The anti-inflammatory effects of procyanidin, however, are not yet fully understood. Through network pharmacology and bioinformatics analysis, it was suggested that procyanidin could modulate ferroptosis and cause anti-inflammatory effects on RAW264.7 cells. This was further evidenced through molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and in vitro experiments. The results indicated that procyanidin could diminish inflammation in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells by regulating ferroptosis via the Nrf2/HO-1/Keap-1 pathway. In conclusion, procyanidin supplementation might be an effective way to reduce inflammation by decreasing the release of inflammatory cytokines and suppressing ferroptosis.
abstract_zh: 炎症是许多医学状况中的常见现象，也是人体的自然防御机制。铁死亡（ferroptosis），一种与脂质过氧化物积累相关的铁依赖性细胞死亡形式，已被发现与炎症有关。然而，原花青素（procyanidin）的抗炎作用尚未完全明了。通过网络药理学和生物信息学分析，提示原花青素可能调节铁死亡并对RAW264.7细胞产生抗炎作用。这进一步通过分子对接（molecular docking）、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和体外实验得到证实。结果表明，原花青素可通过Nrf2/HO-1/Keap-1通路调节铁死亡，从而减轻LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞中的炎症。总之，补充原花青素可能通过减少炎症细胞因子的释放和抑制铁死亡，成为减轻炎症的有效途径。
